title: Concept: Server-side fetch of assembled URL (apex) — review required
description: In apex, setEndpoints*([^)]*+ makes the server issue a request to a computed URL. SSRF weaponizes the server's network position: cloud metadata, internal admin ports, and intranet hosts. The remedy is host allowlisting via a Named Credential endpoint.
applicability: apex server code fetching URLs; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Internal network access and credential theft via metadata endpoints; HIGH severity.
